symptom: ako/mxcli#981 item 7: a view using `sum(1)` / `count(1)` / `count('x')` / `count(true)` builds and runs on PostgreSQL but fails on HSQLDB (42567 "data type cast needed"); a view column `1 as One` reads fine but a consumer's `v.One + 1` returns 11 on HSQLDB (2 on PostgreSQL)
cause: Mendix sends string, integer and boolean literals as untyped `?` parameters (decimals are cast); HSQLDB cannot type them
insight: Database-dependent findings must stay OUT of ValidateOQLSyntax: exec turns every violation it returns into a refusal, whatever the severity. Keep `'TOTAL' as Label` (used in docs) at info so check-mdl stays clean; the fix forms that run are count(<col>), sum(cast(1 as Integer)), sum(case … then 1 else 0 end), cast('…' as String)
